message.content:
Sure! Here’s an overview of some key traffic laws and regulations you’ll find in Texas: | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits vary by road type (e.g., 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates).
• “No‑limit” highways allow speeds up to 75 mph if conditions permit. | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited unless using a hands‑free system. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal for adults.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02%). | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, vehicles turning left must yield to straight‑going traffic.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks. | | **School Bus Laws** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus stops to pick up or drop off children. | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots before changing lanes.
• Passing on the right is only allowed on multi‑lane roads with a solid white line on the left side. | | **Traffic Signal Compliance** | • Red lights mean stop; green means go; yellow means prepare to stop.
• Stop signs require a full stop even if the intersection is clear. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant, crosswalk, or intersection.
• Parking in handicap spaces requires a valid permit. | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must display a valid registration sticker.
• Most vehicles must pass an annual safety inspection. | ### Where to Find Official Texts - **Texas Transportation Code** – The primary source for all traffic statutes. - **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – Provides driver handbooks, forms, and updates. - **Texas Highway Patrol** – Offers enforcement guidelines and public safety advisories. If you need more specific details—like how to file a traffic ticket, appeal a conviction, or understand recent changes—just let me know!
